notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Zombies and an additional nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a nontoken creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five untapped Zombies you control, returning any creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
